Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.34 fixes the chapter 5 fake-uncle warning scene dismissing the same customer twice: the native OnDismiss callback called DismissCurrentClient again, which leaked one next-customer animation lock and left the bell showing “cannot call the next customer” even after the counter was empty. Every warning branch now commits once, and saves with a stuck lock recover when loaded or when the shop opens the next morning. This release also includes 1.33's current-language CG/ending-page fonts, portrait-manager compatibility and retired old-save content cleanup. Routes, outcomes, target days, schedules and endings are unchanged. 1.34 修复第 5 章假叔叔警告场景重复让同一顾客离场的问题：原版 OnDismiss 回调里再次调用 DismissCurrentClient，导致下一次叫号的动画锁多计一次，柜台已无人却永久显示“现在无法呼叫下一位顾客”。所有警告分支现在只提交一次，残留锁会在读档或次晨开店时恢复。本版同时包含 1.33 的游戏当前语言 CG/结局页字体、立绘管理器兼容与旧档内容清理。不改路线、选项结果、目标日、排期或结局。简体中文 / English / 日本語 / 한국어。
